text:
maya: Quick checklist for tomorrow's webinar soundcheck + demo fallback. Can panelists join 60 mins early? Need confirmations on: streaming tokens, demo VPC access, recorded fallback, who triggers fallback. @aj @sam @kim
aj: Can do. I'll be there at T-60. What's the demo endpoint again?
maya: staging endpoint: https://staging.redwood.ai/demo-stream - use token env WEBINAR_TOKEN; token TTL set to 90m currently. Sam can we extend to 3hrs?
sam: I can extend. Will bump TTL and add short note in creds. I'll paste command to fetch token:
sam: ```bash
curl -XPOST https://auth.redwood.ai/get_token -d '{"scope":"webinar"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SEED'
```
kim: We'll also test streaming latency — target <300ms for first byte. AJ, please run a couple of short streams and note initial latency.
aj: On it. Also, demo reads from customer's S3 via VPC peering — confirm route exists for our staging. Opsbot, can you confirm peering?
opsbot: peering-check: status=ok, route=present, last-verified=2026-04-01T09:12:00Z :white_check_mark:
maya: Great. For fallback: if model > 8s per response or rate limit occurs, we swap to recorded demo. Who will press the fallback? @sam volunteer?
sam: :raising_hand: I'll handle fallback toggle. Need a playbook — is there a one-button fallback in console?
aj: Yes — Console -> Sessions -> WebinarDemo -> 'Fallback to Recording' (requires admin). Sam, I'll add you to that group now.
aj: Added. Sam, check you can see the toggle: `role: webcast-admin`
sam: I can see it. Also created a small script to monitor avg token latency and auto-alert:
sam: ```python
# poll endpoint, alert Slack if avg latency > 8s
import requests
# ...
```
kim: Logistics: mic check + stage deck slides at T-40, demo run at T-20, panel Q&A at T+20. We need slide handoff notes for the host.
maya: Host cue sheet: 0-5 intro, 5-20 product, 20-35 demo, 35-50 panel, 50-60 close. I'll DM the host the cue sheet and NFRs.
aj: One more: streaming tokens must include `exp` claim. Sam, when you extend TTL ensure exp aligns with webinar end + 30m buffer.
sam: Will set exp = webinar_end + 1800s. Also uploading a recorded fallback clip to staging bucket: gs://rw-webinar/fallbacks/demo-recording.mp4
maya: Perfect. Anyone else need access to the recording? @kim?
kim: Yes please. Also request transcriptions for the recording for post-webinar content. Marketing ops, please add caption task.
opsbot: task-create: captions request added to #marketing-tasks by maya
maya: :thumbsup: final ask — can we do a 15-min dry-run WED at 9:30am? Panelists confirm their availability please.
aj: Confirm
sam: Confirm
kim: Confirm
maya: Thanks all. I'll update the run-of-show doc and post link in #marketing and DM the host.
